blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reasoning about safety is essential for embodied agents powered by large language models (LLMs). We introduce the Contextual Action and Plan Safety benchmark (CAPSafe), designed to evaluate safety reasoning at two levels: (1) an action-level dataset that tests whether a single action is safe given its environmental context, and (2) a plan-level dataset that evaluates whether agents can generate safe long-horizon plans for complex hazardous household tasks. CAPSafe models safety conditions where hazards are situational (inferred from object properties), multiple hazards can co-occur within the same environment, and each is annotated with a relative severity level for fine-grained analysis. Evaluating nine closed and open-source LLMs reveals a substantial gap between hazard recognition and safe long-horizon planning. Several models achieve high accuracy in recognizing unsafe actions (exceeding 90% in the best cases), yet safe long-horizon planning remains substantially harder. Gemini-3-pro achieves the highest safe success rate (78.19%), while other models remain below 65%. These results highlight that robust safety reasoning over long action sequences remains an open challenge.
blocks.zh: 安全方面的合理性对于由大型语言模型(LLMs)驱动的内含物剂至关重要。 我们采用 " 背景行动和计划安全基准 " (CAPSafe),目的是在两个层面评价安全推理:(1) 行动层面的数据集,该数据集根据环境背景检验单一行动是否安全;(2) 计划层面的数据集,该数据集评估代理人是否能够为复杂的危险家庭任务制定安全的长期计划。 CAPSafe 模型安全条件,在危险是情况性的(从物体属性推导),多种危险可以在同一环境中共同发生,每个都附加了相对严重度的说明,用于精细分析. 对9个封闭型和开放源代码的有限责任管理评价显示,危险识别和安全长距离规划之间存在很大差距。 一些模型在识别不安全行动(在最好的情况下超过了90%)方面实现了高度准确性,但安全的长期范围规划仍然十分困难。 双子座-3-pro取得了最高的安全成功率(78.19%),而其他型号仍然低于65%. 这些结果突出表明,对长期行动序列进行强有力的安全推理仍然是一个公开的挑战。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Embodied agents powered by LLMs are increasingly used to perform complex tasks Huang et al. (2022a) ; Huang et al. (2022b) ; Ahn et al. (2022) ; Singh et al. (2023) ; Sarch et al. (2023) . To operate safely, agents must not only interpret instructions and generate action sequences, but also ensure the safety of these actions. Unsafe actions, such as mishandling appliances or using contaminated objects, can cause physical harm to humans or property, making safety a key requirement for real-world deployment.
Recent work has begun to study safety-aware embodied AI Zhou et al. (2024b) ; Li et al. (2025) ; Zhou et al. (2024a) ; Khan et al. (2025) ; Son et al. (2025) ; Lu et al. (2025) . However, existing benchmarks focus on explicitly dangerous instructions that agents can refuse, rather than situational hazards that must be inferred from the environmental context Yin et al. (2024) ; Liu et al. (2025) . A few others evaluate safety only from final environment states, overlooking unsafe intermediate actions during execution Zhu et al. (2024) ; Sadhu et al. (2025) . Additionally, these benchmarks consider relatively simple environments, involving a single hazard and a few objects, limiting the study of safety in long-horizon settings Zhu et al. (2024) ; Lu et al. (2025) ; Son et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh:
由LLMS提供动力的健壮剂越来越多地用于执行复杂的任务Huang等人(2022a); 黄等人(2022b); Ahn等人(2022年);Singh等人(2023年);Sarch等人(2023年). 为了安全操作,代理人不仅必须解释指令和生成动作序列,而且还必须确保这些行动的安全。 不安全行动,如处理不当或使用受污染的物体,可对人类或财产造成身体伤害,使安全成为现实世界部署的关键要求。
最近的工作已经开始,研究安全意识体现的周AI等人(2024年b);李等人(2025年);周等人(2024年a); 汗等人(2025年); 儿子等人(2025年); 吕等人(2025年). 然而,现有的基准侧重于物剂可以拒绝的明确的危险指示,而不是必须从环境背景Yin等人(2024年);Liu等人(2025年)推断的情况危险。 少数其他评价仅来自最终环境状态的安全性,忽略了处决期间的不安全中间行动Zhu等人(2024年);Sadhu等人(2025年). 此外,这些基准考虑到相对简单的环境,涉及单一的危害和少数物体,限制了对长视环境中的安全性的研究。

blocks.en:
Motivated by these limitations, we introduce the C ontextual A ction and P lan Safe ty ( CAPSafe ) benchmark, comprising two complementary datasets. 1 1 1 https://github.com/Youmna-H/CAPSafe The action-level dataset evaluates whether agents can judge the safety of a single action given its environmental context, while the plan-level dataset evaluates long-horizon safety reasoning by assessing whether agents can generate safe successful plans.
Unlike prior benchmarks, CAPSafe environments contain multiple co-occurring hazards (12 on average), substantially larger scenes (96 objects), and longer tasks (21 steps on average), enabling evaluation of safety reasoning in complex environments. Hazards in CAPSafe are situational, inferred from object properties. We also introduce hazard severity as another dimension that is underexplored in existing benchmarks. A comparison with prior benchmarks is summarised in Table 1 .

blocks.en:
We focus on the reasoning required for safety-aware planning. To isolate this capability, we abstract away from perception and provide agents with structured environment descriptions. This setup enables systematic evaluation of models’ ability to reason about risks and generate safe plans even when the environment is perfectly specified Jia et al. (2024) .
As our results show, models still struggle under these ideal conditions, indicating that safety-aware planning itself remains a challenge.
blocks.zh:
我们侧重于安全意识规划所需的推理。 为了隔离这种能力,我们抽象地脱离知觉,为代理人提供结构化的环境描述. 这种设置使得能够系统地评估模型对风险进行推理和生成安全计划的能力,即使环境被完全指定为Jia等人(2024年))。
正如我们的结果表明,模型仍在这些理想条件下挣扎,表明安全意识规划本身仍然是一个挑战。

blocks.en:
We evaluate nine LLMs (four proprietary and five open-source) under multiple prompting strategies. Our results show that strong action-level hazard recognition does not necessarily translate to safe long-horizon planning.
Our main contributions are as follows: • We construct a contextual action-level safety dataset where action safety depends on object properties and environment state, requiring agents to perform situational reasoning. • We introduce a long-horizon plan-level dataset where agents must complete household tasks in environments containing multiple co-occurring hazards across many objects. These hazards arise over extended action sequences, requiring sustained safety reasoning over long-horizon plans. • We annotate hazards with relative severity levels, enabling fine-grained analysis of model performance across different risk levels. • We systematically evaluate models under different prompting strategies, analyzing how implicit safety knowledge in demonstrations, explicit safety guidelines, and self-reflection affect safety reasoning. • We provide a text-based simulator to detect plan success and safety violations. It operates on structured environment descriptions, enabling controlled evaluation of models’ safety reasoning. We believe CAPSafe complements existing work on embodied AI safety and facilitates evaluation for future research on safety-aware agents.
blocks.zh:

我们的主要贡献如下: 我们构建了一个行动层面的安全数据集,其中行动安全取决于物体特性和环境状态,要求代理人进行情况推理。 我们引入了一个长距离计划层面的数据集,在这个数据集中,物剂必须完成在环境中的家庭任务,其中包含许多物体上多种共同发生的危害。 这些危险产生于行动序列的延长,需要持续的安全推理来解释长远计划。 我们以相对严重程度对危害作出说明,以便能够对不同风险等级的模型性能进行精细分析。 我们根据不同的激励战略系统地评估模型,分析演示中隐含的安全知识、明确的安全准则和自我反省如何影响安全推理。 我们提供了一个基于文本的模拟器,以发现计划的成功和安全的违反。 它根据结构化的环境描述运作,能够对模型的安全推理进行有控制的评价。 我们认为,CAPSafe补充了现有关于人工智能安全的工作,并促进对今后安全意识剂研究的评估。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Recent work has increasingly focused on evaluating physical safety in embodied AI Yang et al. (2024b) ; Zhou et al. (2024b) ; Jindal et al. (2025) ; Li et al. (2025) ; Kim et al. (2026) .
MSSBench Zhou et al. (2024a) evaluates action-level safety classification from visual context but does not assess task planning.
Other benchmarks focus on explicitly hazardous instructions rather than contextual risks: SafeAgentBench Yin et al. (2024) evaluates whether agents can detect and refuse unsafe instructions, while AGENTSAFE Liu et al. (2025) additionally targets hazardous and jailbreak-style prompts.
More recent work moves toward situational and process-level safety.
IS-Bench Lu et al. (2025) evaluates risks arising from intermediate task steps but is limited in the number of hazards and objects per scene.
SafePlan-Bench Huang et al. (2025b) enforces safety constraints on both intermediate actions and final states.
EARBench Zhu et al. (2024) uses an LLM to assess the safety and validity of high-level plans in synthesized risk-inducing scenarios but does not evaluate task success.
SafeMind Chen et al. (2025) evaluates embodied agents across task understanding, perception, and planning, using LLMs to judge both safety and task completion.
VestaBench Sadhu et al. (2025) evaluates situational safety in household environments primarily based on final states rather than process-level safety, while EMBODYGUARD Son et al. (2025) introduces a PDDL-grounded benchmark for diagnosing subtle physical risks across tasks, including safe planning.
Prior benchmarks also do not account for varying hazard severity. Huang et al. (2025a) propose risk-aware task planning using graph neural networks to infer risk scores from scene graphs, but evaluate only a small set of simulated tasks.
ThinkSafe++ Jo and Jang (2025) introduces semantic hazard severity scoring for task planning and demonstrates the value of distinguishing mild from severe hazards, though it is not designed as a benchmark.

blocks.en: Overall, prior benchmarks typically consider relatively simple environments with limited objects, hazards, and short task horizons. In contrast, our benchmark evaluates safety in richer scenes with multiple hazards and longer task horizons, supports online safety assessment during execution, and enables severity-aware analysis (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 总体而言,先前的基准通常考虑相对简单的环境,其对象有限、危险和任务范围短。 对比之下,我们的基准评估了较丰富场景中具有多种危害和较长任务范围的安全性,支持执行期间的在线安全评估,并能够进行重度认知分析(表1)。

blocks.en: 3 Action-level Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 行动一级数据集

blocks.en:
We construct an action-level safety dataset consisting of action - environment description pairs, where the safety of an action depends on its contextual environment. An agent must reason over objects and their properties to determine the safety of executing an action.
We adopt a rule-based dataset construction approach to provide clear and consistent safety specifications, with safety conditions encoded at the object-property level to support systematic variation of environmental context.
Figure 1 provides an overview of the dataset generation pipeline.
blocks.zh:
我们构建了一个由动作-环境描述对组成的动作层面安全数据集,其中动作的安全性取决于其背景环境. 代理人必须就物品及其属性提出理由,以确定执行行动的安全性。
我们采用基于规则的数据集构建方法,提供明确和一致的安全规格,安全条件在物体财产一级编码,以支持环境环境的系统变化。
图1概述了数据集生成管道。

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset Definitions
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集定义

blocks.en:
We define a set of executable agent actions , such as Place(X,Y) and Close(X) (see Appendix A for the full list).
We organize physical risks into five hazard categories : Fire , Electric , Object Damage , Injury and Hygiene/Sanitary ,
under which we define 41 41 hazard causes , each corresponding to an unsafe scenario (e.g., pouring alcohol on a plant or wiping a hot stove burner). 2 2 2 Hazard causes may belong to multiple categories; in such cases, we assign the cause to the most severe category.
blocks.zh:
我们定义了一组可执行代理动作,如Place(X,Y)和Close(X)(完整列表见附录A).
我们把物理风险分为五类:火灾、电、物体损害、伤害和个人卫生。
根据这个定义,我们定义了4141个危险原因,每个危险原因都与不安全的情况相对应(例如,向植物倒酒或擦拭热炉灶燃烧器)。 2 2 危险原因可能属于多个类别;在这种情况下,我们将危险原因归入最严重的类别。

blocks.en:
Our environments are drawn from the TEACH dataset Padmakumar et al. (2022) , which is built on ALFRED scenes Shridhar et al. (2020) and the AI2-THOR simulator Kolve et al. (2017) . 3 3 3 We use the 181 181 environments from the valid-seen split. Each environment contains instances of household object categories (e.g., Microwave , Plate , StoveBurner ), which we extend with additional categories as needed (Appendix A ).
Each object category is associated with properties (e.g., material, temperature, cleanliness or location) that define the environment state and determine whether executing an action is safe or hazardous.
blocks.zh:
我们的环境来自TEACH数据集Padmakumar等人(2022年),该数据集基于ALFRED场景Shridhar等人(2020年)和AI2-THOR模拟器Kolve等人(2017年). 3 3 我们使用来自有效视分裂的181 181个环境. 每个环境都包含家庭对象类别(如微波、Plate、StoveBurner )的例子,我们根据需要将其扩展为其他类别(附录A)。
每个对象类别都与界定环境状态和确定某项行动是否安全或危险的属性(如材料、温度、清洁性或位置)相关联。

blocks.en: 3.2 Hazard Specification
blocks.zh: 3.2 危险规格

blocks.en:
Each hazard cause is defined by three components:
(i) an associated action,
(ii) one or more relevant object categories, and
(iii) a set of object properties whose values determine whether the action is hazardous.
For example, the hazard cause wipe hot stove burner is associated with the action Wipe , object categories such as StoveBurner , Towel , and Cloth , and properties including temperature and is_toggled_on , whose values determine whether executing Wipe is safe.
This representation allows a single action to be safe or unsafe depending on the state of the environment, capturing situational safety in a controlled and interpretable manner. We include full list and details of hazard causes in Appendix H .
blocks.zh:
每一种危险原因由三个部分界定:
(一) 相关行动,
(二) 一个或多个相关物体类别,以及
(三) 一套物体属性,其数值决定该动作是否危险。
例如,危险因子擦拭热炉燃烧器与动作擦拭有关,诸如 Stove Burner、Towel和Cloth 等对象类别,以及包括温度和togled_on在内的属性,其值决定擦拭是否安全。
这种表述方式使单一行动能够根据环境状况而安全或不安全,以可控制和可解释的方式捕捉到情况安全。 我们把危险原因的完整清单和细节列入附录H。

blocks.en: 3.3 Dataset Generation
blocks.zh: 3.3 数据集生成

blocks.en:
For each environment and each hazard cause, we generate both unsafe and safe variants whenever the environment contains the relevant object categories.
Concretely, in order to create an unsafe environment , we copy the original environment and modify the hazard-relevant object properties so that executing the associated action becomes dangerous.
To create a corresponding safe environment , we either retain the original state or modify the same properties to eliminate the hazard. The abstract action is then grounded using concrete object instances (e.g., Wipe(StoveBurner_1, Cloth_1) ), ensuring all preconditions are satisfied. Applying this process across all hazard causes, environments, and object categories yields 732,370 732{,}370 action–environment pairs. To improve balance and diversity, we select the 500 500 most diverse safe and 500 500 most diverse unsafe examples using diversity-based sampling (Appendix C ), resulting in a final dataset of 1,000 1{,}000 examples. Representative examples are shown in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh:
只要环境包含相关的物体类别,我们就会产生不安全和安全的变体。
具体地说,为了创造一个不安全的环境,我们复制原始环境,并修改与危险有关的物体属性,以便执行相关的行动变得危险。
为了创造一个相应的安全环境,我们要么保留原有状态,要么修改相同的属性以消除危险。 然后使用具体对象实例(如擦拭(Stove Burner_1, Cloth_1))来建立抽象动作,以确保满足所有先决条件。 在所有危险原因、环境和物体类别中应用这一过程,可产生732,370 732{,}370 个动作−环境对。 为了改善平衡和多样性,我们选择了500个最多样化的安全例子和500个最多样化的不安全例子,使用基于多样性的取样(附录C),最终形成了1000个1{}000个例子。 代表性实例见图1。

blocks.en: 3.4 Hazard Degree of Severity
blocks.zh: 3.4 危险程度

blocks.en:
Independently of data generation, we associate each hazard cause with a scalar severity proxy in the range [ 1 , 10 ] [1,10] . Severity scores are obtained independently from two LLMs: Claude-Sonnet-4.5 Anthropic (2024) and DeepSeek-R1 DeepSeek AI (2024) . The two models exhibit very strong rank agreement, with Spearman’s correlation ρ = 0.94 \rho=0.94 , indicating a stable relative ordering of hazards. Final severity scores are computed as the mean of the two ratings.
We discretize these scores into four ordinal severity degrees: low , moderate , high , and severe , using thresholds of 1 1 , 4 4 , 7 7 , and 8.5 8.5 , respectively. 4 4 4 Narrower intervals at higher severity levels reflect the empirical score distribution in the data and enable finer discrimination among extreme hazards. As a robustness check, we conducted a human evaluation on a subset of the data. We randomly sampled 30 30 hazard pairs for pairwise comparison, each containing hazards from different severity levels. With four severity levels, there are six cross-level combinations; we sampled five pairs from each, totaling 30 30 . Three judges from our organization independently ranked each pair, and final labels were determined by majority vote. Human rankings agreed with our severity annotations in 93.3 % 93.3\% of cases, supporting their alignment with human judgment. We also evaluated all cross-severity hazard pairs using GPT-5.2 as a third-party judge; its pairwise decisions matched the discretized severity ordering in 84 % 84\% of cases.
We show distribution of hazard categories and degrees in Figure 2 , and association between hazard causes and degrees in Appendix H .

blocks.en: 4 Plan-level Dataset
blocks.zh: 4 计划一级数据集

blocks.en: While action-level data evaluates whether agents can assess the safety of individual actions in context, long-horizon settings require generating plans that satisfy safety constraints throughout execution. We therefore introduce a plan-level dataset to assess whether agents can generate safe long-horizon plans given an environmental context. Concretely, given a task that is in principle safely executable, an agent must produce a plan that completes the task while avoiding hazardous situations. This benchmark tests whether safety knowledge exhibited at the action level persists under long-horizon planning.
blocks.zh: 虽然行动层面的数据评价了代理人是否能够评估具体情况下的个别行动的安全性,但长远环境要求制定计划,满足整个执行过程中的安全限制。 因此,我们采用了一个计划一级数据集,以评估在环境背景下,物剂是否能够产生安全的长视距计划。 具体地说,鉴于原则上可以安全执行的任务,代理人必须制定完成这项任务的计划,同时避免出现危险情况。 这一基准检验在行动一级所展示的安全知识是否在长期规划下继续存在。

blocks.en: We construct the benchmark using environments from TEACH, where each scene is paired with a long-horizon household task. We select 9 9 tasks provided by TEACH (e.g., boil a potato , make breakfast ) and introduce 9 9 additional tasks to broaden hazard coverage (e.g., wipe all stove burners , make coffee with milk ). 5 5 5 New objects required by these tasks are added to the environments as needed. The resulting dataset contains 243 243 task instances, each paired with a hazardous environment. Dataset statistics are shown in Figure 2 , with full task details provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 我们利用TEACH的环境来构建基准,每个场景都配以长距离的家庭任务。 我们选择了TEACH提供的9项任务(如煮土豆,做早餐),并引入了9项额外的任务,以扩大危险范围(如擦拭所有炉灶燃烧器,用牛奶煮咖啡). 5 5 5 这些任务需要的新物品,根据需要添加到环境中. 由此产生的数据集包含243 243个任务实例,每个实例都与危险环境对齐。 数据集统计数据如图2所示,全部任务细节见附录B。

Hazardous environments are generated using the same property-editing procedure as in the action-level dataset (Section 3 ), but we allow multiple hazards to co-occur within a single environment. On average, each scene contains 12 12 potential hazards, substantially more than in prior benchmarks (Table 1 ), with approximately 5 5 occurring during execution and 7 7 arising after task completion. This design reflects the complexity of long-horizon tasks, where distinct hazards may arise at different steps and involve different objects (e.g., expired ingredients, dirty utensils, or appliance-related risks during cooking). Property modifications are restricted to task-relevant objects (e.g., potato, sink, pot, and stove for boil a potato ).
In addition to hazards that may occur during execution, we also enforce post-execution safety checks to ensure that agents do not leave the environment in an unsafe state. Violations of these checks (e.g., leaving appliances toggled on or storage units open) are treated as hazards and contribute to safety evaluation.
blocks.zh:
使用与行动一级数据集(第3节)相同的属性编辑程序生成危险环境,但我们允许在一个单一环境中共同发生多种危险。 每个场景平均包含12个潜在危害,大大超过先前的基准(表1),其中约5个发生在执行期间,7个发生在任务完成后。 这种设计反映了长距离任务的复杂性,在不同步骤上可能会出现不同的危害,并涉及不同的物体(如过期的成分,脏餐具,或烹饪过程中与电器相关的风险). 财产改造仅限于与任务有关的物品(例如土豆、水槽、锅和煮土豆的炉子)。
除了在执行期间可能发生的危险外,我们还实施执行后的安全检查,以确保特工人员不会离开不安全的环境。 违反这些检查(例如,将电器切开或打开储存装置)被视为危险,有助于安全评估。

blocks.en: For every task instance, at least one safe plan exists. Hazards can be avoided either by generating appropriate mitigating actions (e.g., removing metal objects from a microwave or cleaning dirty dishes) or by selecting safer object alternatives (e.g., choosing fresh ingredients or using already clean utensils). Table 7 illustrates a representative task instance, enumerating hazards that may arise during and after execution and the corresponding mitigation strategies.

blocks.en:
Our goal is to evaluate models’ safety reasoning and planning in complex long-horizon scenarios with co-occurring hazards. Therefore, we implement a text-based simulator, inspired by ALFWorld and ScriptWorld Shridhar et al. (2021) ; Joshi et al. (2023) , that measures plan success and safety. The simulator operates on structured environment states and approximates AI2-THOR execution while abstracting away navigation, focusing on interactive actions. This controlled setting reduces simulator-induced complexity Padmakumar et al. (2023) ; Farag et al. (2025) and limitations such as representing properties like wet or expired , enabling direct evaluation of safety reasoning with various hazards. A dedicated safety-checking module monitors hazards during and after execution.
The simulator supports the full action set defined in Appendix A . Each action is associated with predefined preconditions (e.g., a cabinet must be open before placing an object inside) and effects that update the environment state upon successful execution (e.g., toggling on a coffee machine with a mug inside fills the mug with coffee).
A task is considered successful if the final environment state matches the target goal state. For TEACH tasks, we use the provided goal specifications; for our additional tasks, we define analogous goal states (e.g., for task coffee with milk, there should be a mug filled with coffee and milk in the final state).
blocks.zh:
我们的目标是在具有共同危害的复杂长距离情景中评价模型的安全推理和规划。 因此,我们在ALFWorld和ScriptWorld Shridhar等人(2021年);Joshi等人(2023年)的启发下,实施了基于文本的模拟器,以衡量计划成功和安全。 模拟器在结构化环境状态上运行,并大致显示AI2-THOR执行,同时抽象离开导航,专注于交互动作. 这种控制环境降低了模拟器引起的复杂程度Padmakumar等人(2023年);Farag等人(2025年)以及诸如代表湿度或过期等特性等限制,从而能够直接评价各种危险的安全推理。 一个专门的安全检查模块监测执行期间和之后的危险。
模拟器支持附录A定义的全部动作。 每个动作都与预先设定的前提条件有关(例如,在将一个对象放进去之前必须打开一个柜子),并在成功执行时更新环境状态的效果(例如,在咖啡机上用里面的杯子夹着一个杯子将杯子填满咖啡).
如果最终环境状态与目标状态相符,则一项任务被视为成功。 对于TEACH任务,我们使用所提供的目标规格;对于我们的额外任务,我们定义了类似的目标状态(例如,对于配有牛奶的任务咖啡,最终状态下应该有一个装满咖啡和牛奶的杯子).

blocks.en:
Plans are executed sequentially by the simulator. Before each action is executed, the safety checker determines whether the action results in a hazard given the current environment state. This allows hazards to be counted based on actual execution outcomes rather than static plan inspection.
Finally, the simulator inspects the terminal state for residual hazards and penalizes agents that introduce unsafe conditions (e.g., leaving a stove burner on). Evaluating safety both during and after execution captures a broad range of hazardous behaviors Huang et al. (2025b) ; Lu et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh:
计划由模拟器依次执行. 在每次动作执行之前,安全检查员根据当前环境状况决定动作是否导致危险. 这样就可以根据实际执行结果而不是静态计划检查来计算危险。
最后,模拟器检查终端状态的残余危险,并惩罚引入不安全条件的制剂(例如留下炉灶燃烧器). 评估执行期间和之后的安全性,包括广泛的危险行为 Huang et al. (2025b) ; Lu et al. (2025).

Our model choices are further motivated by recent work on planning and safety Son et al. (2025) ; Sadhu et al. (2025) ; Zhao et al. (2025) ; Cross et al. (2025) .

blocks.en: For the action-level dataset, each model is given an action–environment pair and asked to classify it as safe or unsafe , along with a justification following chain-of-thought prompting Wei et al. (2022) . A general safety reminder is included in the prompt.
blocks.zh: 对于动作层面的数据集,每个模型都得到了一个动作对—环境,并被要求将它归类为安全或不安全的,同时在引发Wei等人(2022年)的思想链之后给出一个理由。 提示中包括一般安全提醒。

blocks.en:
For the plan-level dataset, we prompt the model with task description, environment specification and available actions, and ask it to generate a plan that successfully completes the task. We employ few-shot prompting to illustrate desirable planning behavior Song et al. (2023) .
Specifically, we manually construct two pools of few-shot examples. Each example consists of a task, an environment, and a plan that successfully completes the task. The normal pool contains examples set in hazard-free environments, demonstrating standard successful planning. The hazardous pool contains the same examples but with hazards introduced to the environment, paired with plans that avoid risks through appropriate actions or safe object choices. For each test instance, we retrieve the top two most similar examples using Sentence-BERT Reimers and Gurevych (2019) .
Using the plan-level dataset, we evaluate five prompting strategies, each designed to probe a distinct aspect of safety-aware planning: • Base : tests whether LLMs possess implicit safety knowledge and can apply it to planning. The model is prompted using few-shot examples from the normal pool. • +SafEx ( Safety from Examples ): examines whether LLMs can infer and apply safety-relevant constraints from demonstrations. In this setting, few-shot examples are drawn from the hazardous pool, where plans demonstrate risk-aware behavior. • +Guide : evaluates whether LLMs can leverage explicit safety knowledge expressed in natural language Zhu et al. (2024) . In this setting, we augment the Base prompt with general safety guidelines that summarize dataset hazards, generated using GPT-5, while continuing to draw few-shot examples from the normal pool. • +SafEx+Guide : combines demonstration-based and instruction-based safety signals by incorporating explicit safety guidelines in the prompt and drawing few-shot examples from the hazardous pool. • +Reflect : evaluates self-reflection for improving safety-aware planning. After generating an initial plan, the model is prompted to identify potential hazards and revise the plan by selecting safer object alternatives or adding corrective actions. Self-reflection occurs prior to execution to proactively mitigate risks. The reflection prompt builds on the +SafEx+Guide setting. This approach has shown effectiveness in embodied AI tasks Farag et al. (2025) ; Khan et al. (2025) ; Liu et al. (2023) . We decouple planning from execution (i.e., models generate a complete plan in a single shot which is then executed and checked for safety). This design focuses on models’ ability to reason about safety over extended action sequences.
We also conducted preliminary experiments with ReAct Yao et al. (2022) , which interleaves planning and execution, but observed no significant improvements. We hypothesize this is because the environment is fully observable and all relevant information is available before execution, limiting the benefit of iterative replanning.
The generated plans are evaluated using three metrics: Success Rate (SuR) , the proportion of tasks that achieve the target goal; Safety Rate (SaR) , the proportion of tasks with no hazards detected by the safety checker; and Safe Success Rate (SSR) , the proportion of tasks that are both successful and safe. Full prompts are included in Appendix G .
blocks.zh:
对于计划层面的数据集,我们用任务描述,环境规格和可用行动来推动模型,并要求它生成一个成功完成任务的计划. 我们用几发催泪弹来说明可取的规划行为。
具体地说,我们手动构建了两个短镜头例子集合。 每个例子都包含一个任务,一个环境和一个成功完成任务的计划. 正常的集合包含在无危险环境中设置的例子,显示了标准的成功规划. 危险池中也有同样的例子,但有引入环境的危害,并附有通过适当行动或安全物体选择避免风险的计划。 使用Pried-BERT Reimers和Gurevych(2019年),
利用计划一级数据集,我们评估了五个促进战略,每个战略都旨在探索安全意识规划的一个不同方面: 基础:测试LLMs是否拥有隐含的安全知识,并可用于规划。 该模型是使用普通池中少有镜头的例子来推动的. • +SafEx(从实例看安全):审查LLMS是否能够推断和适用示威中与安全有关的限制。 在此情况下,从危险池中取出很少的镜头例子,在这些池中,计划显示了意识到风险的行为. • +指南:评价LLMS能否利用用自然语言Zhu等人表达的明确安全知识(2024年)。 在此情况下,我们用汇总数据集危害的一般安全准则(使用GPT-5生成的数据集危害)来扩大基地,同时继续从正常的集合中抽取几个镜头的例子。 • +SafEx+指南:将基于示范的安全信号和基于指导的安全信号结合起来,将明确的安全准则纳入即时指南,并从危险集合中抽取少部分镜头的例子。 • + 参考:评估自我反思,以改进安全意识规划。 在制定初步计划后,促使该模型通过选择更安全的物体替代品或增加纠正行动,查明潜在危害并修改计划。 自我反省发生在执行之前,以主动减少风险。 反思提示基于+SafEx+指南设置. 这种方法在体现的AI任务中显示出效力:法拉格等人(2025年);汗等人(2025年);刘等人(2023年). 我们把规划与执行脱钩(即模型在一次射击中生成一个完整的计划,然后执行并检查安全性)。 这一设计侧重于模型在延长的动作序列上对安全进行推理的能力。
我们还与ReAct Yao等人(2022年)进行了初步实验,这些实验相互交织规划与执行,但没有观察到显著的改进. 我们假设,这是因为环境是完全可观察的,在执行前可以获得所有相关信息,限制了迭代规划的好处。
对生成的计划使用三个衡量标准进行评估:成功率(SuR),实现具体目标的任务比例;安全率(SAR),安全检查器检测到没有危险的任务比例;安全成功率(SSR),既成功又安全的任务比例。 附录G载有全部提示。

blocks.en: 6 Results
blocks.zh: 6 结果

blocks.en: 6.1 Action-level Results
blocks.zh: 6.1 行动层面的成果

blocks.en:
Table 3 shows that, overall, Qwen3-32B achieves the best performance, attaining the highest accuracy ( 92.6 % 92.6\% ) and the strongest recall on safe actions ( 93.4 % 93.4\% ), while maintaining a high recall on unsafe actions ( 91.8 % 91.8\% ). Gemini achieves the highest recall on unsafe actions ( 99.2 % 99.2\% ), but exhibits a pronounced gap with its recall on safe actions ( 77.3 % 77.3\% ). A similar pattern is observed for GPT-5-mini and Claude, indicating a conservative bias that favors rejecting actions as unsafe. This over-cautious behaviour is consistent with observations in prior safety benchmarks Li et al. (2024) ; Zhou et al. (2024a) .
While larger models such as GPT-4.1, Llama-3.3-70B, and Qwen2.5-72B exceed 75 % 75\% accuracy, their performance remains insufficient for high-stakes physical safety settings. Smaller models (Qwen3-4B and Mistral-7B) perform substantially worse, indicating weaker safety reasoning capabilities.
blocks.zh:
表3显示,总的来说,Qune3-32B的成绩最好,达到了最高的准确度(92.6%,92.6)和最强的安全行动召回率(93.4%),同时保持了对不安全行动的高度召回率(91.8 % ) 。 双子座对不安全行动召回率最高(99.2%,99.2 % ) , 但与对安全行动的召回率差距很大(77.3%)。 GPT-5-mini和Claude也有类似的模式,这表明保守的偏见倾向于将行动视为不安全。 这种过于谨慎的行为符合先前安全基准Li等人(2024年);周等人(2024年a年)的意见。
虽然GPT-4.1,Llama-3.3-70B,Quen2.5-72B等较大型的型号超过了75%的75QQ精度,但其性能仍不足以进行高收量的物理安全设置. 较小的模型(Qune3-4B和Mistral-7B)的性能更差,表明安全推理能力较弱.

blocks.en:
To further examine safety sensitivity, we analyze performance across different hazard degrees of severity. Figure 3 reports recall on unsafe actions for each severity level. Overall, models exhibit strong performance on severe hazards, often exceeding their mean unsafe recall. However, performance does not increase monotonically with hazard severity as we observe a drop in recall for high-severity hazards, which remain critical (e.g., toggle on microwave
containing sponge or place a device in water). This exposes a vulnerability in current models, suggesting that they do not consistently scale their safety reasoning with increasing hazard severity.
The high recall on unsafe actions of Gemini (Table 3 ) is reflected across all hazard severity levels, with performance approaching 100 % 100\% . This is followed by Qwen3-32B, GPT-5-mini and Claude which maintain relatively stable recall across high and severe hazards. Per-hazard category results are shown in Table 6 .
blocks.zh:
为了进一步审查安全敏感性,我们分析不同危险程度严重性的表现。 图3报告回顾了每个严重程度的不安全行动。 总体而言,模型在严重危害方面表现强劲,往往超过了平均不安全的召回率。 但是,随着危险的严重程度,性能不会单调增加,因为我们观察到,高度严重性危害的召回率下降,这些危害仍然很严重(例如,切换微波)
含有海绵或将装置放置在水中。 这暴露了在目前模型中的脆弱性,表明这些模型没有以日益严重的危险程度来连贯地扩大其安全推理。
对双子座不安全行动(表3)的高召回率反映于所有危险程度,性能接近100%100。 接下来是Qune3-32B、GPT-5-mini和Claude,它们在高度和严重危害中保持相对稳定的召回。 表6显示了每类灾害的结果。

blocks.en: 6.2 Plan-level Results
blocks.zh: 6.2 计划一级的成果

blocks.en: Table 4 reports plan-level performance. Proprietary models substantially outperform open-source models in task completion, with Gemini-3-pro achieving the highest Success Rate (SuR) of 93.83 % 93.83\% . However, enforcing safety in long-horizon planning remains challenging across all systems: the Safe Success Rate (SSR) drops considerably for every model, indicating that many successful plans still violate safety constraints. Even the strongest model, Gemini-3-pro +Reflect, achieves an SSR of 78.19 % 78.19\% , indicating a large room for improvement. Several models achieve over 91 % 91\% unsafe-action recall in the action-level setting (Table 3 ), yet still struggle with plan-level safety. This gap is particularly evident for Qwen3-32B, which achieves the best overall action-level performance, but attains only 51.65 % 51.65\% Safety Rate (SaR) in planning. These findings highlight that models can recognize unsafe actions in isolation, but struggle to consistently enforce safety constraints across extended action sequences.
blocks.zh: 表4报告计划一级的执行情况。 专有模式在任务完成方面大大超过开源模式,双子座-3-pro成功率最高(SuR)为93.83% 93.83\%. 然而,在所有系统中,在长距离规划中加强安全仍然具有挑战性:每个模式的安全成功率都大幅下降,这表明许多成功计划仍然违反安全限制。 即使是最强的型号双子座-3-pro + Reflect,也实现了78.19%78.19\%的SSR,表明有很大的改进空间. 一些模式在行动层面(表3)实现了超过91%的91%的不安全行动召回(表3),但仍在计划层面的安全方面遇到困难。 这一差距在Qune3-32B中尤其明显,它取得了最佳的整体行动水平业绩,但在规划中只达到了51.65%的51.65%的安全率。 这些结论突出表明,模型可以孤立地识别不安全的行动,但努力在广泛的行动序列中始终坚持实施安全限制。

blocks.en:
Few-shot safety examples (+SafEx) consistently improve SSR over the Base setting, suggesting that models can learn safety behaviours from few-shot demonstrations. In contrast, adding safety guidelines (+Guide) are mainly beneficial for stronger proprietary models, while having limited impact on smaller open-source models. This indicates that applying high-level safety principles requires stronger reasoning capabilities, consistent with prior findings Yang et al. (2024b) ; Sadhu et al. (2025) .
To control for potential bias from GPT-generated guidelines, we evaluate Qwen2.5-72B with self-generated guidelines and observe comparable SSR ( 16.1 % 16.1\% with Qwen guidelines vs. 18.52 % 18.52\% with GPT ones), suggesting that guideline ineffectiveness is not driven by cross-model bias.
Combining examples and guidelines (+SafEx+Guide) generally yields the strongest non-reflective performance, while self-reflection (+Reflect) further improves Safety Rate (SaR), particularly for stronger models. However, reflection often reduces task success (SuR), revealing a trade-off between safety and task completion.
blocks.zh:
少有镜头安全实例(+SafEx)在基地设置上不断改进安保部门改革,说明模型可以从少有镜头的演示中学习安全行为。 相比之下,增加安全准则(+Guide)主要有利于更强大的专有模型,同时对较小的开源模型影响有限. 这表明,适用高级别安全原则需要更强有力的推理能力,与先前的调查结果保持一致。 杨等人(2024b); 萨德胡等人(2025).
为了控制来自GPT生成的指南的潜在偏差,我们用自生成的指南来评价Quen2.5-72B,并遵守可比的SSR(16.1%的Qwen指南对18.52%的18.52%的GPT),这表明指南无效不是由跨模型偏差驱动的.
将实例和准则(+SafEx+Guide)结合,一般产生最强的非反射性能,而自我反射(+Reflect)则进一步提高了安全率(SAR),特别是对于更强大的模型. 然而,反思往往会降低任务的成功率(SuR),揭示出安全与任务完成之间的权衡.

blocks.en:
Figure 4 analyzes hazard severity for the three strongest models. Across all severity levels, the enhanced variants substantially lower hazard rates compared to the base model. However, high-severity hazards remain particularly challenging: even strong models such as GPT-5-mini and Claude still trigger roughly 15 % 15\% of high-severity hazards on average.
Self-reflection yields the largest reduction in high-severity hazards across all three models, especially for Gemini, suggesting that explicit plan verification is particularly effective for mitigating critical failures.
We further analyze tasks that finish unsafely by examining when hazards occur. Averaged across all +Reflect variants, 67 % 67\% of unsafe tasks involve hazards occurring during execution, indicating that models struggle to maintain safety constraints throughout planning. 8 8 8 On average, 67 % 67\% of unsafe tasks involve during-execution hazards, 19 % 19\% involve post-execution hazards, and 14 % 14\% involve both. Interestingly, Gemini exhibits a different failure profile, where 62 % 62\% of unsafe tasks are caused by post-execution hazards. This suggests that Gemini’s stronger reasoning capabilities better maintain local execution safety, yet still fail to reliably reason about terminal environment conditions.
blocks.zh:
图4分析了三种最强模型的危害严重性。 在所有严重程度上,强化变体与基准模型相比,危害率大幅降低。 然而,高度严重性危害仍然特别具有挑战性:即使是GPT-5-mini和Claude等强力模型,平均仍然引发大约15%的高度严重性危害。
自我反射导致所有三种模式中,特别是双子座的高严重性危害减少最多,这表明明确计划核查对减轻重大故障特别有效。
我们进一步分析在危险发生时不安全地完成的任务。 平均在所有+参考变体中,67%的不安全任务涉及执行过程中发生的危险,这表明模型在整个规划过程中都难以维持安全限制。 8 8 平均而言,67%的不安全任务涉及执行期间的危险,19%涉及执行后的危险,14%涉及两者。 有趣的是,双子座显示出不同的故障剖面,其中62%的62%的不安全任务是由执行后的危险造成的. 这说明双子座更强大的推理能力能更好地维护当地执行安全,但对于终端环境条件仍然不能有可靠的理由.

blocks.en: Finally, we analyze how models respond once hazards are encountered. Across +Reflect variants, 57 % 57\% of encountered hazards remain unmitigated. When mitigation occurs, models are more likely to apply corrective actions ( 32 % 32\% ; e.g., cleaning a plate before use) than substitute safer objects ( 11 % 11\% ; e.g., selecting a clean plate). The strongest models mitigate substantially more hazards; for example, Gemini resolves roughly 70 % 70\% of encountered hazards, though this remains insufficient for reliable physical safety. These results suggest models struggle with integrating mitigation strategies to hazards they encounter in long-horizon planning.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们分析模型如何在遇到灾害时作出反应。 在整个“反射”变体中,57%57%的危害仍未减轻。 当缓解发生时,模型比替代更安全的物体(11% 11 %;例如,选择干净的板块)更可能应用纠正行动(32% 32 %;例如,使用前清理一个板块)。 最强的模型可以大大减轻更多的危害;例如,双子座可以解决约70%的70%的危害,尽管这仍然不足以保证可靠的人身安全。 这些结果表明,在长期规划中,在将减灾战略与所遭遇的危害结合起来方面存在着各种模式。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced CAPSafe, a benchmark for evaluating safety in embodied agents across action-level contextual safety judgments and plan-level task execution. Our evaluation shows that strong models can accurately detect unsafe actions given rich environmental context, while safe and successful long-horizon planning remains challenging, particularly in the presence of high-severity hazards.
Furthermore, safe planning demonstrations consistently improve safe task completion, whereas abstract safety guidelines are only effective for proprietary models, and several models benefit from self-reflection.
We hope CAPSafe provides a foundation for future work on safety-aware planning.
blocks.zh:
我们采用了CAPSafe,这是在行动层面对安全作出判断和计划层面执行任务时,在体现的代理人中评价安全的基准。 我们的评价表明,由于环境环境丰富,强有力的模型能够准确检测不安全的行动,而安全、成功的长距离规划仍然具有挑战性,特别是在存在高度严重危害的情况下。
此外,安全规划示范不断改进安全任务完成情况,而抽象的安全准则只对专利模式有效,一些模式从自我反省中受益。
我们希望CAPSafe为今后安全意识规划工作奠定基础。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
CAPSafe evaluates safety using a symbolic text-based simulator with structured environment states, abstracting away perception and low-level control. This design enables controlled and interpretable evaluation by isolating models’ safety reasoning over actions and plans, without confounding errors from perception or sensing. While real-world systems must handle perceptual uncertainty, our formulation provides a clean testbed for analyzing reasoning failures. Importantly, this framework is compatible with upstream perception modules (e.g., scene graph generation), allowing future work to integrate learned perception while retaining structured reasoning evaluation.
Hazards in CAPSafe are defined through a rule-based framework informed by real-world safety practices, prior work, and LLM-assisted generation, covering 41 41 hazard causes and their configurations. This approach enables systematic and reproducible evaluation, though it may omit rare hazards arising from uncommon scenarios. At the same time, it is readily extensible to additional hazards, object properties, and more diverse environments, making expanded coverage a natural direction for future work.
Finally, CAPSafe focuses on household environments as a representative and practically relevant domain for embodied agents. The benchmark is readily extensible to other safety-critical domains, such as outdoor navigation or industrial manipulation, enabling broader evaluation of safety-aware planning in future work.
blocks.zh:
CAPSafe使用具有结构化环境状态的象征性文本模拟器来评价安全性,抽象出感知和低级控制. 这种设计能够通过将模型的安全推理与行动和计划分开来进行控制和可解释的评价,而不会混淆感知或感知的错误。 虽然现实世界的系统必须处理观念上的不确定性,但我们的表述为分析推理失败提供了一个干净的试验床。 重要的是,这个框架与上游感知模块(如场景图生成)兼容,使得未来的工作能够整合学到的感知,同时保留结构化推理评价.
CAPSafe中的危害通过基于规则的框架加以界定,该框架以现实世界的安全做法、前期工作和LLM辅助生成为基础,涵盖4141个危害原因及其配置。 这种办法有助于进行系统和可复制的评价,尽管它可能忽略了不同寻常的情景所产生的罕见危险。 与此同时,它很容易扩大到更多的危险、物体特性和更多样化的环境,使扩大的覆盖范围成为今后工作的自然方向。
最后,CAPSafe将家庭环境作为代表和实际相关的领域,用于体现的代理人。 该基准很容易扩展到其他安全关键领域,例如户外导航或工业操纵,从而能够对未来工作中的安全意识规划进行更广泛的评价。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: CAPSafe is intended as a benchmark for evaluating safety-related reasoning in embodied agents, rather than as a certification of deployment readiness. Performance on CAPSafe provides evidence about an agent’s ability to recognize and enforce safety constraints, but does not account for other factors that affect real-world safety, such as perception errors, actuation uncertainty, or unmodeled environmental dynamics. CAPSafe should therefore be interpreted as one component of a broader safety evaluation pipeline, complementing system-level testing and validation in physical environments. Furthermore, the environments and tasks in CAPSafe are grounded in household settings that primarily reflect common practices and layouts found in European and North American homes, and may not fully capture object usage or environmental configurations present in other cultural or regional contexts.
blocks.zh: CAPSafe旨在作为评估包含的物剂中与安全有关的推理的基准,而不是作为部署准备状态的证明。 CAPSafe的性能提供了一种证据,证明代理人有能力识别和执行安全限制,但没有考虑到影响现实世界安全的其他因素,如感知错误、激活不确定性或未建模的环境动态。 因此,CAPSafe应被解释为更广泛的安全评价程序的一个组成部分,以补充系统层面的测试和实体环境中的验证。 此外,CAPSafe的环境和任务基于主要反映欧洲和北美家庭常见做法和布局的家庭环境,可能无法充分掌握其他文化或区域背景下的物体用途或环境配置。

blocks.en: We select a fixed-size subset of instances that is maximally diverse, where diversity is defined in terms of semantic dissimilarity measured using sentence embeddings and cosine similarity. Selection is performed using a greedy farthest-point strategy in embedding space, ensuring that each newly selected instance is minimally similar to those already chosen. The procedure is applied independently to safe and unsafe examples in order to preserve dataset balance.
blocks.zh: 我们选择一个大小固定的子集,以最大限度的多样化为例,其中多样性用句子嵌入和余弦相似度测量的语义差异来定义. 选择是在嵌入空间时使用贪婪的最远点策略进行的,确保每个新选择的实例与已经选择的最小相似. 该程序独立适用于安全和不安全的例子,以保持数据集平衡。

blocks.en: Each instance in the dataset is first mapped to a normalized textual representation capturing only information relevant for comparison, including the action, hazard cause and category, and a filtered snapshot of the environment containing only objects referenced by the action along with their properties. All instances are embedded using Sentence-BERT Reimers and Gurevych (2019) , and pairwise cosine similarities are computed. The initial instance is chosen as the one with the lowest average similarity to all others. Subsequent instances are selected iteratively by minimizing the maximum similarity to the current selection set, thereby encouraging coverage of semantically distinct scenarios.
blocks.zh: 数据集中的每一个实例首先被绘制成一个规范的文本表示,只捕捉与比较有关的信息,包括动作、危险原因和类别,并过滤出环境的快照,只包含动作引用的对象及其属性。 所有实例都使用Pried-BERT Reimers和Gurevich (2019) 嵌入, 并计算成对的余弦相似性 。 初始案例被选为与所有其他案例平均相似度最低的案例。 通过尽量减少与当前选择集的最大相似性,反复选择以后的实例,从而鼓励涵盖各式各样的情景。

blocks.en: Performance analyzed by hazard category and severity degree for GPT-4.1, Qwen2.5-72B, Qwen3-32B, Qwen3-4B, Llama-3.3-70B, and Mistral-7B is shown in Figures 8 – 13 . These figures are intended for within-model comparisons across variants, rather than for direct cross-model comparison. This is because the frequency of hazards is influenced not only by safety behavior but also by overall planning competence: a model may incur fewer hazards in unsuccessful executions simply by deviating from the task (e.g., interacting with irrelevant but safe objects). The figures report hazards aggregated over both successful and unsuccessful executions. For cross-model comparison on plan-level data, we rely on the Safe Success Rate (SSR) reported in Table 4 , which jointly accounts for task completion and safety.
blocks.zh: 按危险类别和严重程度分析的GPT-4.1、Quen2.5-72B、Qune3-32B、Qune3-4B、Llama-33-70B和Mistral-7B的性能见图8-13。 这些数字是为了进行不同变体的模型内部比较,而不是直接进行跨模型比较。 这是因为危害的发生频率不仅受到安全行为的影响,而且受到总体规划能力的影响:一个模型仅仅通过偏离任务(例如与无关但安全的物体互动),在不成功的处决中,危害可能减少。 这些数字表明,成功和失败的处决都造成了危害。 在对计划一级数据进行跨模式比较时,我们依靠表4中报告的安全成功率,后者共同说明任务的完成和安全。
